sentences.text:
Applicant :- Sumitra Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Himanshu Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- Amit Daga,G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State, learned counsel for the informant and perused the material available on record.

Present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, with a prayer to release the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.47/2023 under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC, Police Station Mahuwakheda, District Aligarh, during pendency of trial.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is further submitted that the applicant is aged about 70 years and is an illiterate lady.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the controversy involved in the present case is purely of civil nature for which, a civil proceeding is already pending before the competent Court.
Just to create a pressure upon the applicant, present FIR has been lodged.

It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant was not aware about the sale-deed executed between her and Vendee (Manoj Gautam) and even the entire amount of sale consideration has been transferred to the account of co-accused Sushil and thereafter, to the Sumitra Devi vs State Of U.P. on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129765158/
1 account of Vendee (Manoj Gautam).

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Even if, for the sake of argument, the entire allegations made in the FIR are taken as it is, even then no offence is made out against the applicant and the only offence is made out against the co-accused persons, namely, Sushil, Manoj and Kailash.
The land in question is already a disputed land.
In the present incident, the applicant has been used as a Puppet.
It is next argued that no manipulation has been made by the applicant and the main authors of the crime are co-accused Sushil and Gautam.

The applicant is suffering from a serious disease, namely,
collapse uterus.
She is in languishing in jail since 20.6.2023, having no criminal history.
If the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail.

Per contra, learned AGA assisted by learned counsel for the informant, vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that admittedly, the applicant has executed the sale-deed in question in favour of the vendee and initially, the sale consideration amount has been transferred to the bank account of the applicant, and thereafter, to the bank account of co-accused Sushil and then to the bank account of co-accused Manoj, as alleged by learned counsel for the applicant.
They further submitted that after perusal of the entire material available on record, it appears that present is a clear cut case of impersonation.
It is undisputed that fraud has been played with the individual as well as with the Society at large.
The applicant was actively involved in the entire transaction.
The amount so deposited in the account of the applicant was transferred to the accounts of co-accused persons through cheques, which indicates that those cheques were signed by the applicant.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of evidence and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that no case is made out to grant bail to the applicant.
The present bail application is, accordingly, rejected.
However, learned trial court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously.

Order Date :- 15.7.2024 RKK/-
